88594.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  3. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  4. You are in one location (workplace); write down its name.
  5. That location has one invoice created this month (for example 1.00 hour at $100.00). Write down its subtotal (for example $100.00).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • For 5: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example "ZZAUTOTEST Entry Fleet"); then Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = a technician (for example Tech ShopView), Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). The subtotal is on the Finance tab.
88594.custom_steps:
1. Look at the top navigation bar and read the entries from left to right.
  2. Click "Dashboard" in the top navigation.
  3. Read the location name at the top right (beside your initials) and the Revenue tile's headline.
  4. Click the arrow icon beside the word "Revenue" on the Revenue tile (it opens the Sales report on the same range) and read the report's total for that workplace.
  5. Sign out (profile icon at the top right > Logout).
  6. Sign in again as the same user.

88601.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time on several different days this month and in the last twelve months.
  4. Your role can create a work order and an invoice in that location (Admin can).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, Revenue on This Month is above $0.00 and Technician Efficiency on This Month shows a percentage (not -); switch both pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
88601.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and leave every tile on its default range.
  2. Write down the Revenue headline.
  3. Click the arrow icon beside "Revenue" (it opens the Sales report on the same range) and read the report's total for the invoices' subtotals at the foot of the table.
  4. Go back to the dashboard, write down the Billing Efficiency headline, then click its arrow icon (Service Advisor Analysis report) and read the report's overall figure with all advisors selected.
  5. Go back, write down the Technician Efficiency headline, then click its arrow icon (Technician Efficiency report, Invoiced) and read the overall figure with all technicians selected.
  6. Go back, write down the Technician Utilization headline, then click its arrow icon (Technician Utilization report) and read the overall figure with all technicians selected.
  7. Go back, write down the Sales by Customer headline, then click its arrow icon (Sales By Customer report) and read how many customers the report lists in total (e.g. the pager reads "1 - 10 of 69").
  8. Create one new invoice in the same location today: Work Orders > Create Work Order > a customer and asset > Save; in New Line add a labor line (e.g. Labor Rate EVR Travel to EVO, $100 an hour, Estimated Time 1) and tick Line Approved > Save & Close; Story > Update; Complete; Mark Reviewed; Finance > Create Invoice.
  9. Within one minute, reload the dashboard and read the Revenue headline.
  10. Reload the Sales report on the same range and read its total.

88609.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).

  3. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  4. You are in a location (workplace) with customers who have not been invoiced for a while.
  5. At least one customer shows in the At Risk table at 60 days whose Last Invoice Date is between 60 and 119 days ago (the automated version of this case seeds its own customer with one invoice about 90 days old; a manual tester uses the existing customers).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • For 5: Check: on the Dashboard set At Risk Customers to 60 days and click View details: at least one row has a Last Invoice Date 60 to 119 days ago. If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data. Do this check in your normal browser window, not in the private window you test in (the dashboard remembers choices). Then set the At Risk window back to 120 days.
88609.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and look at the At Risk Customers tile's window pill.
  2. Click the window pill and read the options.
  3. Close the menu and read the headline and the supporting line.
  4. Click View details on At Risk Customers, count the table rows (all pages) and read their Last Invoice Date values.
  5. Open the window pill and pick 60 days.
  6. Read the headline, the supporting line, the trend line and the table again.
  7. Try each of 30, 90 and 180 days the same way, noting for each the headline and the end of the supporting line.

88610.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) with at-risk customers.
  4. In that location's At Risk table (Dashboard > View details on At Risk Customers) there are two customers whose invoices are inside the last twelve months: Customer A with Lifetime Invoices 1 and a parts-only invoice (e.g. Revenue (12 Mo) $40.50), and Customer B with Lifetime Invoices 2 or more. You have written down both names and the At Risk headline.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: the At Risk Customers tile shows a number above 0. If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
  • For 4: read the table's Lifetime Invoices and Revenue (12 Mo) columns; to see whether an invoice has only parts: Customers > the customer > Invoices tab (turn Open only off). Invoices cannot be back-dated, so if no such customers exist, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no such customers exist.
88610.custom_steps:
1. Count the points on the At Risk trend line and compare its last point with the headline.
  2. On Customer A's invoice (Customers > Customer A > its work order > Finance tab > invoice three-dot menu > Issue Credit), credit every part on it and submit.
  3. Reload the dashboard and read the At Risk headline. Look for Customer A in the table.
  4. Credit every part on Customer B's latest invoice the same way.
  5. Reload the dashboard and look for Customer B in the table.
  6. Change the window pill to 60 days.
  7. Close the browser tab, open the site again in the same browser and open the dashboard.
  8. Click Dashboard in the top menu in a private window.
  9. Change your computer's time zone to one several hours away (computer settings > Date & Time), reload the dashboard and read the At Risk headline. Then set the time zone back.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
